response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg), g AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS grp_avg FROM j GROUP BY ordertypedist), x AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM j GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist) SELECT x.transreg, x.ordertypedist, x.avg_short_interest, x.avg_option_volume_ratio, x.avg_short_interest / g.grp_avg AS ratio FROM x JOIN g ON g.ordertypedist IS x.ordertypedist ORDER BY (x.avg_short_interest / g.grp_avg) IS NULL, x.avg_short_interest / g.grp_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The order type mix average short interest is the average of shortintrt over all matched sentiment rows with that ordertypedist (row-level), not an average of per-transaction averages. The ratio is the transaction's average divided by that group average.

A transaction with several sentiment rows is one output row, with averages taken over its rows. NULL values are ignored by AVG. A ratio is NULL when the transaction's average is NULL or the group average is NULL or zero (SQLite returns NULL for division by zero).

alternatives.interpretation: The order type mix average is the mean of the per-transaction average short interest values (each transaction weighted equally), rather than a mean across all sentiment rows.
